subject: Settlement cutover: invoice handoff, ledger reconciliation, and staggered payment plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Ayla Turner <ayla.turner@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Settlement cutover: invoice handoff, ledger reconciliation, and staggered payment plan

Hi Ayla —

Hope you’re well. We’ve completed the end-of-term reconciliation for Orchid’s account and are ready to hand over the final invoice and ledger allocation. Attached is the final PDF invoice for the period ending May 2026, plus a CSV that breaks down usage credits, prepaid balances, and the proposed allocation across the two renewals that rolled over into Q2.

Can you confirm the following so we can finalize the collection path?
- Confirm the PO number you want on the invoice (if you need us to reissue with a PO).
- Confirm whether Orchid will pay the balance in one wire or in two staggered tranches (preferred dates noted below).
- VAT/residency: we currently show Orchid as US-resident for tax purposes; if you need a VAT/Reverse Charge handling for any EU entity under Orchid, please advise which legal entity.

Proposed stagger: 60% by 2026-06-30, 40% by 2026-07-15. If you can do a single wire, please confirm and we’ll issue a final remittance instruction.

Attachments: RDW_Inv_202605_Final_Orchid_2026-06.pdf (pdf), ledger_alloc_Orchid_2026-06.csv (csv)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ayla Turner <ayla.turner@orchidhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@orchidhealth.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Settlement cutover: invoice handoff, ledger reconciliation, and staggered payment plan

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the package. A couple of quick notes from our side after an initial pass:
- We have PO# OR-2026-331 that needs to be on any invoice for Accounting to accept. Can you reissue the PDF with that included?
- Our procurement team prefers a single wire if the final amount is <= USD 75k; do you have the final net after credits? The CSV is helpful, but can you confirm the single-amount total we should wire?
- VAT: Orchid has a small EU subsidiary (Orchid EU Ltd) that incurred a portion of the usage in April. We will need an allocation line that shows which charges map to Orchid EU Ltd and whether Redwood has EU VAT registration for those charges or we should apply reverse charge.

Payments team, can you confirm whether you will be able to accept a single wire?

Thanks — I’ll loop back once we confirm PO and internal approval.

Best,
Ayla Turner
Head of Finance Operations
Orchid Health
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Settlement cutover: invoice handoff, ledger reconciliation, and staggered payment plan

Laura / Grace —

Forwarding Ayla’s reply. Action items we need to close from RDW side:
1) Reissue invoice with PO# OR-2026-331 and confirm single-amount total after credits.
2) Confirm allocation lines for Orchid EU Ltd and provide VAT treatment note (do we charge VAT or do reverse charge?). Grace — can you check whether we have EU VAT registration for this customer or whether we need to provide a VAT self-billing note?
3) If they prefer single wire and total is <=75k, confirm treasury can accept and provide final wire instruction (include bank name, ABA/IBAN, remittance reference).

I’ve attached the ledger CSV for reference (ledger_alloc_Orchid_2026-06.csv). I’d like to get this closed by EOD Friday so we can schedule collection next week.

Thanks,
Sean

[Attachment: ledger_alloc_Orchid_2026-06.csv]
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Settlement cutover: invoice handoff, ledger reconciliation, and staggered payment plan

Sean —

On the invoice: I’ll regenerate the PDF and include PO OR-2026-331. Final amount after credit = USD 68,420.00 (see line 12 of the CSV for the credit application). That meets their <=75k single-wire threshold.

Grace — quick VAT ask: per our vendor table, Redwood has a UK VAT registration (GB999999999) and limited OSS/MSP presence — however, we did not register Orchid EU Ltd as a separate buyer. Two possible options:
- Option A (preferred for speed): We issue the invoice net and include an allocation line that invoices Orchid EU Ltd’s usage as a net reverse-charge line (no VAT charged), and add a VAT note pointing them to self-account for reverse charge. We will need their VAT number.
- Option B: If Orchid requires we charge VAT, we need their EU legal entity to be onboarded and we’d need to issue a VAT-inclusive invoice which may delay collection by ~5 business days while finance confirms tax handling.

I'll attach the reissued PDF and the remittance instructions for a single wire. Sean — please confirm you’re happy with Option A (net reverse-charge allocation) and I’ll send to Ayla.

Attachments: RDW_Inv_202605_Final_Orchid_2026-06_PO-OR-2026-331.pdf (pdf), RDW_Wire_Instructions_Operations.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Ayla Turner <ayla.turner@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, payments@orchidhealth.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Settlement cutover: invoice handoff, ledger reconciliation, and staggered payment plan

Ayla —

Thanks, appreciate the quick review. We’ve taken the path to minimize waiting:
- Invoice reissued with PO OR-2026-331 attached (RDW_Inv_202605_Final_Orchid_2026-06_PO-OR-2026-331.pdf).
- Final single-wire amount (net of credits): USD 68,420.00.
- VAT handling: per Laura’s note, we will allocate Orchid EU Ltd usage as a reverse-charge (net) line on the invoice. Please confirm Orchid EU Ltd’s VAT number so we can include it on the document. If you prefer us to charge VAT directly instead, please indicate and we’ll take the slightly longer path.
- Wire details and remittance reference are in the attached RDW_Wire_Instructions_Operations.pdf.

Next steps on your side: confirm VAT number for Orchid EU Ltd and whether payments@orchidhealth.com will initiate the wire by 2026-06-30. If we get confirmation today, Laura will mark the invoice as final and our cash operations team will watch for the incoming funds.

If helpful, we can schedule a 15-minute bridge to finish the PO + VAT confirmation — otherwise I’ll proceed on Option A once you confirm the VAT number.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: RDW_Inv_202605_Final_Orchid_2026-06_PO-OR-2026-331.pdf, RDW_Wire_Instructions_Operations.pdf]
